notes: Two taḥwīl branches: the first ends at «عبد الله بن نمير» after «ح»; the second («وحدثنا ابن نمير») writes its own names to the end, so there is no shared tail
«حدثنا أبي»: bare kin pronoun, a relation link (rule 7)
«قال سألت سعيد بن جبير»: the asker is Uthman; the one asked and answering, Sa'id, is a link (rule 5)
